name: Calendar
summary: Standalone calendar surface. Three view modes — month (the canonical grid), week (7-column day-rows), agenda (event-grouped list). Distinct from DatePicker (single-value input + popover calendar) — this is the full-screen / detail-card calendar primitive used for scheduling, availability, and resource views. Localized via date-fns / Intl. Honors the system week start.

value.description: ISO date currently focused. Defaults to today.

events.description: Array of { id, start (ISO), end (ISO), title, tone? }.

selected.description: ISO date / [start, end] / array of ISO depending on selection.

disabledDates.description: Predicate (date) => boolean or array of ISO dates.

keyboard: ArrowLeft / ArrowRight - move focus between days
ArrowUp / ArrowDown - move focus across weeks
Home / End - first / last day of week
rules: Month grid uses role='grid' + role='row' + role='gridcell'.
Each gridcell carries a full aria-label: 'Wednesday, May 15, 2026, has 2 events, selected'.
Inline-style position math for the agenda-view event tracks per AGENTS.md hard rule 12 (avoid Tailwind arbitrary translate-x).
Today is marked aria-current='date'; selected is aria-selected='true'.
Honor prefers-reduced-motion: drop month-transition slide; cut to the new month with a fade.

do: Show the current month + year header with prev/next IconButtons; clicking the header jumps to a year-picker.
Render the weekday row in type.eyebrow.mono uppercase.
Render today's cell with a 2 px accent ring; selected cell with action.selected.bg filled.
When events are passed, render up to 3 dot indicators below the day number; '+N' beyond.
Use tabular-nums for day numbers so column edges align across months.
dont: Don't paint the selected cell in solid lime fill — use action.selected.bg.
Don't disable weekends without making it explicit in the day-number color.
Don't render the calendar without weekday headers.

changelog.note: Initial Calendar contract (beta). Month / week / agenda views. Single + range + multi selection.
